Can we separate these code to small commits?

I saw these code supports many functions such as:
+ event handler
+ OEM File transfer
+ Configuration discovery

Although this is META OEM code but I think it is better to have goods commit history so we can see which is supported in which commits.
Can we also use `enum class`?
Should we check size of eventData before use to prevent overflow?

Can we separate create new function for the long code?
One function for each `RecordType::`?

It will be great if this 8xx lines functions can be split in to small ones.

its better to write logs which does not have acronyms.
rc={RC} is anti-pattern, Can we avoid to use that format?

Please add method description.
Can you also check the others method and add the description if does not have?
These code is duplicated in many *.hpp file. Can we create default method for this function?

size={SIZE} is anti-pattern. https://github.com/openbmc/docs/blob/master/anti-patterns.md#ill-defined-data-structuring-in-lg2-message-strings
`size={SIZE}` -> `size {SIZE}`
The same comment for others output logs.
With lg2 don't need `e.what()` just `e`.
